semantics.table: administrative reassignment; Host snapshot + expected epoch; post-ACK observation; recipient fetch queries Host
semantics.direct: conditional transfer by current exclusive holder; Installed receipt then authenticated recipient claim
semantics.recipient_ready_components: sum of two client-local command durations, includes encoding, FF, RPC and materialization; excludes Python gap
semantics.recipient_ready_wall: driver end-to-end elapsed including Python dispatch and scheduling between installed and recipient-ready
semantics.host_segments: single Host steady clock; drain timestamp is observation of last pin completion in decision domain
semantics.p99: descriptive sample quantile, no stable tail-latency or cross-machine claim
